rows.grounds: compound bahuvrihi/locative qualifier referring to the region at the middle of the body
object of suspension; ritual cord composed of five threads
prescriptive optative prohibiting suspension in the specified region

items.question: Why is suspension of the five-cord prohibited at the middle of the body?
premises: The ritual context specifies permissible regions for placing or extending the five-cord.
The middle of the body is identified as a distinct location.
The injunction explicitly negates suspending the five-cord there.
items.inference: Therefore, the five-cord must not be allowed to hang down at the middle of the body.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of the paṃcasūtra in this passage is not fully specified in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: One should not let the five-cord hang down at the middle of the body.
